# Versions CI installs (resolved and tested together on Python 3.10 and 3.11).
# transformers >= 5 disables its PyTorch backend below torch 2.6, so torch and
# transformers move together.  Newer transformers / numpy / flake8 dropped 3.10.
torch==2.10.0
transformers==5.22.1; python_version >= "3.11"
transformers==5.20.2; python_version < "3.11"
numpy==2.4.6; python_version >= "3.11"
numpy==2.2.6; python_version < "3.11"
flake8==7.5.0; python_version >= "3.11"
flake8==7.4.1; python_version < "3.11"
datasets==5.1.0
tokenizers==0.23.3
safetensors==0.8.0
optuna==5.0.0
tqdm==4.70.1
psutil==7.2.2
fastapi==0.115.9
uvicorn==0.34.3
httpx==0.28.1
pytest==9.2.0
ruff==0.17.4
